Class MetadataInspectionEvent

  • java.lang.Object
    • batch.MetadataInspectionEvent

  • public final class MetadataInspectionEvent
extends java.lang.Object
    Immutable domain event representing an inspected metadata property, tag entry, XMP record, raw parsed Metadata container object, or structural output delimiter extracted from a media file.

    23 September 2026
    Version:

    Author:

    • Constructor Detail

      • MetadataInspectionEvent

        public MetadataInspectionEvent(java.lang.String line)
        Creates a metadata inspection event representing a raw structural delimiter or line-formatted header without associated media property attributes.
        Parameters:
        line - the raw string content or line-formatted header to emit

      • MetadataInspectionEvent

        public MetadataInspectionEvent(MediaRecord record,
                               java.lang.String group,
                               java.lang.String name,
                               java.lang.Object value)
        Creates a metadata inspection event containing an extracted attribute, EXIF tag, or XMP data entry for a media record.
        Parameters:
        record - the source media record being inspected
        group - the metadata category, directory, or XMP group name, such as "[EXIF]", "[System]", or "[XMP-dc]"
        name - the name of the metadata tag, property, or XMP element
        value - the formatted display value or raw object representation of the attribute

      • MetadataInspectionEvent

        public MetadataInspectionEvent(MediaRecord record,
                               Metadata<?> metadata)
        Creates a metadata inspection event wrapping a complete parsed Metadata container associated with the inspected media record.
        Parameters:
        record - the source media record being inspected
        metadata - the parsed metadata tree container object
